blocks.text: You can create perimeter policies to easily define how Microsegmentation handles inbound, outbound, and internal traffic (e.g., Block, Sim Block, Allow) for managed resource groups.
You can create a perimeter policy from the Resource Groups page when creating a resource group. To learn more, see Configuring Resource Groups.
The following steps describe how to add a perimeter policy from the Perimeter Policies page in the Zscaler Admin Console.

blocks.item: From the navigation menu, go to Zero Trust Cloud > Microsegmentation > Perimeter Policies.
The Add Perimeter Policy drawer opens.
In the Add Perimeter Policy drawer:
Resource Group: Select a resource group.
Order: Select the order of the perimeter policy. The policy is ordered last by default.
App Zones: Click the checkbox to Include all AppZones or select your preferred AppZones.
Inbound Traffic Enforcement: Select Sim Block, Block, or Disable.
Outbound Traffic Enforcement: Select Sim Block, Block, or Disable.
Internal Traffic Enforcement: Select Allow or Disable.

blocks.text: The perimeter policy is added to the Perimeter Policies page.
